name: EU AI Act 2024 — AGP Policy Pack
description: Implements EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689) obligations for AGP-governed AI agents. Covers prohibited practices (Article 5), high-risk system obligations (Articles 6-27), transparency requirements (Article 50), and GPAI model obligations (Articles 51-56). Register this manifest as a PolicySet in your AGP Registry to attribute PolicyDecisions to specific EU AI Act articles.
articles_covered: Article 6  — Classification of high-risk AI systems
Article 50 — Transparency obligations for certain AI systems
Annex III  — High-risk AI systems referred to in Article 6(2)
